findings.status: confirmed-by-static-counterexample; inherited, not introduced by RSA migration
findings.title: Expired nonzero Plus expiry deletes valid Free connection-token cache
findings.cause: is_plus compares expiry to now, but cache invalidation checks expiry > 0 instead of the computed active subscription status. An expired positive timestamp and cached Free token therefore look like a gained Plus subscription on every refresh.
findings.impact: Deletes current/next valid Free cache before broker subkey/signing RPCs. If refresh subsequently fails, callers lose a usable cache fallback and may wait/fail until broker recovery. Actual broker behavior returning expired Some(timestamp), and a live user-visible incident, were not exercised.

counterexample.execution: Boolean counterexample to source condition; no Rust/live account execution

findings.recommended_next_action: Separate source-owned repair using computed is_plus for level transition; deterministic tests must cover expired nonzero expiry with cached Free and failing broker, preserving valid cache. Keep migration and inherited-fix provenance distinct.

protocol_observations.result: unblind consumes Pending on every return; length validation then expected epoch then configured-root Merkle verification over exact response used_key bytes precede finalization.

Token generated before untrusted subkey fetch; request level selects Plus/Free root; malformed configured roots fail instead of falling back to None; DB publication occurs only after success. None remains explicit inherited no-root mode.

Configured bandwidth key is fallibly parsed before tasks; each pending binds its requested key. Single response uses backend mathematical n/e equality to tolerate equivalent PKCS1/SPKI encodings, with no alternate issuer fallback.

New deserializers preserve Vec/array/newtype wire representation while bounding advertised lengths, reserve capacity and decoded fixed-size elements. Direct public DTO bypasses also call validate before cryptography.
Caller trust predicate and verify_strict precede exposing payload; JsonSigned authenticates original literal bytes before deserializing. Runtime file byte-identical to upstream.

Cancellation drops scoped geph5_rt Task handles; retained geph5-rt0.3.8 Drop aborts underlying task. Real retained tests check mock RPC drainage; cancellation is not a synchronous join or general SQL rollback guarantee.

retained_evidence.vector_boundary: e3/e65537 2048-bit and e65537 2049-bit, PKCS1/SPKI. Legacy verification rejects non-octet2049 vectors; only accepted legacy cached vectors are round-tripped. New adapter signatures checked by retained legacy oracle.

unresolved.status: Known inherited unbounded response.bytes()/JSON allocation before bounded Mizaru DTO validation; transport size/JSON depth hardening not proven by DTO tests.

Retained tests cover cancellation before signing/write and committed misc db_write semantics; they do not prove notification/recovery for an already-submitted bandwidth INSERT canceled before BW_TOKEN_SUPPLIED.notify. Reachable operational failure not established; no new confirmed finding asserted.

SOURCE differs from retained fixture aggregate in manifest/package paths, lock and SQLite revision. Reused byte-equivalent protocol/client tests do not establish fresh full-candidate compile, accounts, broker interoperability in production, Intel/Windows ABI or installed behavior.

No new protocol-authentication or serialization defect found in reviewed migration; FFI/math/side-channel/entropy assurance belongs to separate backend review and cannot be inferred from absence of findings here.
